create_watermark_logits_processor: create a WatermarkLogitsProcessor instance with custom gamma and delta parameters for LLM watermarking
call_watermark_processor: call the WatermarkLogitsProcessor with input_ids and scores to apply watermark bias to logits
seed_rng_with_token: seed the watermark RNG using the previous token and a hash key for deterministic greenlist generation
get_greenlist_ids: get a randomized greenlist of token IDs based on gamma ratio and the current RNG state
bias_greenlist_logits: bias the logits of greenlist tokens by adding the delta value to their scores
